_help: Announcement banner. Each notice shows between its start and end time (Central Time offsets). Edit text here and push; no code changes needed. Keep wording factual and nonpartisan.

notices.title: In-person early voting starts Monday, Oct. 19
notices.body: Vote at any early voting location in your county through Friday, Oct. 30. Mail ballot applications must be received by Oct. 23.

notices.title: Vote early through Friday, Oct. 30
notices.body: Any early voting location in your county works. Bring one of seven approved photo IDs. Mail ballot applications must be received by Oct. 23.

notices.title: Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 3
notices.body: Vote at your assigned polling place or a countywide vote center, depending on your county. Bring one of seven approved photo IDs. In line by 7 p.m.? You can still vote.
